Returns Policy

You can return most new, unopened items fulfilled by Amazon AU within 30 days of receipt of delivery for a replacement or full refund of the price you paid for the item if you change your mind - see About Replacements and About Refunds.

To return faulty items see our Returning Faulty Items policy.

Product description

BEAUTY OF JOSEON Dynasty Cream is a creamy moisturiser with a firm, smooth texture that leaves the skin with a radiant glow. Made with rice bran water, ginseng root water and niacinamide, it works by brightening dull complexion, maintaining ample moisture to prevent premature aging of the skin while enhancing skin barrier. Ceramides and hyaluronic acid are added to help give the skin a plumper and fresh appearance.

  • Z Chamarette
    5.0 out of 5 stars This cream instantly plumps and hydrates your skin
    Reviewed in Australia on 5 May 2024
    Size Name: 1 count (Pack of 1)Verified Purchase
    I recently tried the Beauty of Joseon Dynasty Cream moisturizer and I must say, it is absolutely amazing! This cream has transformed my dry and dull skin into a radiant and hydrated one, keeping me moisturized all day. The texture of the cream is very light and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy residue. The delicate, floral scent is also a plus for me, as it gives a refreshing and soothing experience.

    What I love most about this moisturizer is that it not only hydrates my skin but also improves its overall texture and elasticity. It contains nourishing ingredients like ginseng root extract, honey extract, and shea butter, which are known for their anti-aging and skin rejuvenating properties. Since I started using this moisturizer, my skin looks more plump, smooth, and youthful.

    I also appreciate the fact that this cream is free from harmful chemicals like parabens, sulfates, and phthalates. It is cruelty-free and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.

    Overall, I highly recommend the Beauty of Joseon Dynasty Cream moisturizer to anyone looking for a luxurious and effective skincare product that delivers visible results and keeps you hydrated all day. It is definitely worth the investment and has become a staple in my daily skincare routine.

Product description

BEAUTY OF JOSEON Dynasty Cream is a creamy moisturiser with a firm, smooth texture that leaves the skin with a radiant glow. Made with rice bran water, ginseng root water and niacinamide, it works by brightening dull complexion, maintaining ample moisture to prevent premature aging of the skin while enhancing skin barrier.
